#{couponId}

SELECT S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.ORG_ID FROM SYSTEM_STORE_INFO S WHERE S.deleted = b'0'
AND S.STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{storeName}, '%')
AND S.STORE_ID IN ( SELECT C.STORE_ID FROM USER_COUPON_RECORD C WHERE C.deleted = b'0' AND C.COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND C.BUSINESS_ID = #{businessId} )

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(id),0) as useNum, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount),0) as turnover, IFNULL(SUM(coupon_amount),0) as offerTotal, IFNULL(COUNT(id),0) as orderNum, IFNULL(SUM(item_num),0) as itemNum, store_id as storeId, DATE(create_time) as createDate FROM user_coupon_record WHERE deleted = b'0' AND coupon_id = #{couponDataDownloadReqVO.couponId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{couponDataDownloadReqVO.startTime} AND #{couponDataDownloadReqVO.endTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time),store_id
